video.title: Mountain Weather Update 10/20, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description: Snowmaking is underway in CO.  Next storm system hits the West 10/21-10/23 with splits into two areas of low pressure.  One goes north and one might go south and develop 10/24-10/26 in NM/CO.  Freezing levels start at higher elevations then gradually drop.  There is another storm system end of month into the first week of November but it is delayed.
